game.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine
game.blurb: Third-person shooter from Relic Entertainment, published by SEGA and THQ, released 2011-09-05. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Campaign: First Half
chapters.summary: The first four hidden campaign milestones: regrouping with the Command Squad, getting into the breach, silencing the cannon and carrying the power source. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Campaign: Second Half
chapters.summary: The last four hidden milestones, up to the end of the campaign. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Hard Difficulty
chapters.summary: Part 1 on Hard in one sitting without dying, and the whole game on Hard.

chapters.title: Restricted Loadout Chapters
chapters.summary: Clearing a campaign chapter with only one pair of weapons, four times over.

chapters.title: Servo Skulls
chapters.summary: Collecting 10 Servo Skulls, then all of them.

chapters.title: Campaign Combat
chapters.summary: Kill counts, executions, headshots, Fury, Ground Pound, Charge, multi-kills, Ork Nobs and 'Ard Boyz.

chapters.title: Multiplayer
chapters.summary: Character levels, classes, weapon and armor challenges, Seize Ground, Annihilation and customising both sides.

chapters.title: Exterminatus and Chaos Invasion Co-op
chapters.summary: The Exterminatus arenas and the Chaos Invasion co-op mission with its three arenas, bonus wave and team challenges.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 55150)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Warhammer_40,000:_Space_Marine
Fandom (warhammer40k.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://warhammer40k.fandom.com/wiki/Space_Marine_(Game)
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 12756); RAWG keeps "Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Master Crafted Edition" (2025-06-10) and Space Marine 2 separately. The Steam store list has the original as app 55150, now titled "Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Anniversary Edition", and the Master Crafted Edition as a separate app 3169520; 55150 was used because it matches the 2011 RAWG entry. Its schema is named "ValveTestApp55150" (a placeholder name) and has 60 achievements, 9 hidden. StrategyWiki has "Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine" at completion stage 0 (marked as a perfect stub article): only its Table of Contents (about 2,400 characters) is written. Its contents list Gameplay, Controls, Weapons, Achievements and trophies, Enemies, Walkthrough and 18 campaign chapters (Chapter 1: Planetfall to Chapter 18: Epilogue), none of them written, so it was not used; no other title was tried because the page exists. warhammer40k.fandom.com answers the API, redirecting to "Space Marine (Game)", with about 138 linked articles (mostly lore names); names only were looked at, nothing copied. Eight hidden achievements have API names starting SP_PROGRESS (campaign milestones); they are split into two halves by unlock rate (76.7% for Command Squad down to 31.9% for "Here, At the End of All Things"), our own choice. The hidden "Die, Heretics" (SP_COMBAT_SKILL_CHAOS_SPACE_MARINE_KILL) is a kill count, so it sits in combat. "Armored in Glory" (armor challenges) and "True Son of the Emperor" (40,000 kills across all modes) have MP_ API names and sit in multiplayer. Ten achievements have DLC API names: nine ACH_DLC_60_CHAOS_INVASION and one ACH_DLC_2_STEAM_WINTER naming the Exterminatus arenas Kalkys Facility Escape and Hab Center Assault; RAWG lists no additions for this game, so the chapter is named after the modes in the descriptions.
